newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN RETAIL TRADE FALLS IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN RETAIL TRADE FALLS IN APRIL.

text.p: Romanian retail trade firms' April turnover slipped by 1.6 percent from March in real terms, due to a 5.8 percent fall in the turnover of companies selling non-food products, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed.

The CNS said turnover of retailers of food products, beverages and tobacco products had gone up by 8.1 percent in April from the previous month. "This was the first time since the start of the year that this product group registered a growth compared to the previous month," the CNS said.
Private retailers took 68.9 percent of the January-April turnover level of retail trade companies, data showed.
